hooks.command: python3 -c 'import json,sys,re;d=json.load(sys.stdin);f=(d.get("tool_response") or {}).get("filePath") or (d.get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path") or "";sys.exit(0) if not f.endswith("README.md") else None;s=open(f,encoding="utf-8").read();[print("warning: unbalanced <"+t+"> tags in "+f+" ("+str(len(re.findall("<"+t+r"\b",s,re.I)))+" open, "+str(len(re.findall("</"+t+">",s,re.I)))+" close)") for t in ("div","table") if len(re.findall("<"+t+r"\b",s,re.I))!=len(re.findall("</"+t+">",s,re.I))]' 2>/dev/null || true
